    Minor stability fixes related to game saving/loading

notes.title: Version 1.21 is live
notes.notes:
A new patch (1.21) with minor bug fixes is now live.

Improvements:

    Minor stability improvements
    Added reference to SMB community channels in loading screen and on stadium fences in-game


Bugs Addressed:

    Customizing players can inadvertently change pitcher/batter animations (original fix was incomplete)
    Computer can go into sleep mode while running SMB
    Crash when using mouse-wheel scroll in team advancement list view
    Possible crash when Windows username contains non-ASCII characters

notes.title: Version 1.20 is now live
notes.notes:
A new patch (bug fixes only) is now live.

Bugs Addressed

Newly substituted pitcher occasionally fails to throw a pitch
Game fails to make correct ruling on balls bouncing out-of-play in foul territory
Post-game scoreboard sometimes displays incorrect stadium name
Customizing players can inadvertently change pitcher/batter animations


Please let us know if you experience any new issues with this patch!

notes.title: Extra Innings release date set
notes.notes:
A release date of August 21st has been locked in for the PC version of Super Mega Baseball: Extra Innings.

More details can be found over on our blog. Most notably, we decided to set the release one week after the Xbox One date (which is August 14th) to buy a little extra time for beta testing, especially on the new keyboard and mouse input scheme.

We're looking forward to next Friday!
